Introduction
1 Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled[a] among us, 2 just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and __LOCAL_ROLE_02__ of the word. 3 With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent __RECIPIENT_A__, 4 so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

The Birth of __PERSON_C__ the Baptist Foretold
5 In the time of __RULER_A__ king of __LOCAL_PLACE_01__ there was a __WORKER_A__ named __PERSON_A__, who belonged to the priestly division of __DIVISION_A__; his wife __PERSON_B__ was also a descendant of __FOREFATHER_B__. 6 Both of them were righteous in the sight of __MOST_HIGH_A__, observing all the __MASTER_A__ commands and decrees blamelessly. 7 But they were childless because __PERSON_B__ was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.

8 Once when __PERSON_A__ division was on duty and he was serving as __WORKER_A__ before __MOST_HIGH_A__, 9 he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the __PLACE_A__ of the __MASTER_A__ and burn __MATERIAL_A__. 10 And when the time for the burning of __MATERIAL_A__ came, all the assembled worshipers were __REQUEST_A__ outside.

11 Then an angel of the __MASTER_A__ appeared to him, standing at the right side of the __LOCAL_OBJECT_01__. 12 When __PERSON_A__ saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear. 13 But the angel said to him: “Do not be afraid, __PERSON_A__; your __REQUEST_A__ has been heard. Your wife __PERSON_B__ will bear you a son, and you are to call him __PERSON_C__. 14 He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth, 15 for he will be great in the sight of the __MASTER_A__. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the __SPIRIT_A__ even before he is born. 16 He will bring back many of the people of __PEOPLE_A__ to the __MASTER_A__ their __MOST_HIGH_A__. 17 And he will go on before the __MASTER_A__, in the spirit and power of __PROPHET_A__, to turn the hearts of the parents to their __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the __MASTER_A__.”

18 __PERSON_A__ asked the angel, “How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years.”

19 The angel said to him, “I am __MESSENGER_B__. I stand in the presence of __MOST_HIGH_A__, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news. 20 And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their appointed time.”

21 Meanwhile, the people were waiting for __PERSON_A__ and wondering why he stayed so long in the __PLACE_A__. 22 When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the __PLACE_A__, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

23 When his time of service was completed, he returned home. 24 After this his wife __PERSON_B__ became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. 25 “The __MASTER_A__ has done this for me,” she said. “In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”

The Birth of __PERSON_F__ Foretold
26 In the sixth month of __PERSON_B__ pregnancy, __MOST_HIGH_A__ sent the angel __MESSENGER_B__ to __VILLAGE_A__, a town in __REGION_A__, 27 to a __LOCAL_ROLE_03__ pledged to be married to a man named __PERSON_E__, a descendant of __KING_A__. The __LOCAL_ROLE_03__’s name was __PERSON_D__. 28 The angel went to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The __MASTER_A__ is with you.”

29 __PERSON_D__ was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be. 30 But the angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, __PERSON_D__; you have found favor with __MOST_HIGH_A__. 31 You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him __PERSON_F__. 32 He will be great and will be called the Son of the __HONORED_A__. The __MASTER_A__ __MOST_HIGH_A__ will give him the throne of his father __KING_A__, 33 and he will reign over __ANCESTOR_B__ descendants forever; his kingdom will never end.”

34 “How will this be,” __PERSON_D__ asked the angel, “since I am a __LOCAL_ROLE_03__?”

35 The angel answered, “The __SPIRIT_A__ will come on you, and the power of the __HONORED_A__ will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called[b] the Son of __MOST_HIGH_A__. 36 Even __PERSON_B__ your relative is going to have a __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__ in her old age, and she who was said to be unable to conceive is in her sixth month. 37 For no word from __MOST_HIGH_A__ will ever fail.”

38 “I am the __MASTER_A__ __LOCAL_ROLE_02__,” __PERSON_D__ answered. “May your word to me be fulfilled.” Then the angel left her.

__PERSON_D__ Visits __PERSON_B__
39 At that time __PERSON_D__ got ready and hurried to a town in the __LOCAL_PLACE_02__, 40 where she entered __PERSON_A__ home and greeted __PERSON_B__. 41 When __PERSON_B__ heard __PERSON_D__ greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and __PERSON_B__ was filled with the __SPIRIT_A__. 42 In a loud voice she exclaimed: “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__ you will bear! 43 But why am I so favored, that the mother of my __MASTER_A__ should come to me? 44 As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy. 45 Blessed is she who has believed that the __MASTER_A__ would fulfill his promises to her!”

__PERSON_D__ Song
46 And __PERSON_D__ said:

“My soul glorifies the __MASTER_A__
47     and my spirit rejoices in __MOST_HIGH_A__ my Savior,
48 for he has been mindful
    of the humble state of his __LOCAL_ROLE_02__.
From now on all generations will call me blessed,
49     for the Mighty One has done great things for me—
    holy is his name.
50 His mercy extends to those who fear him,
    from generation to generation.
51 He has performed mighty deeds with his arm;
    he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.
52 He has brought down rulers from their thrones
    but has lifted up the humble.
53 He has filled the hungry with good things
    but has sent the rich away empty.
54 He has helped his __LOCAL_ROLE_02__ __PEOPLE_A__,
    remembering to be merciful
55 to __ANCESTOR_A__ and his descendants forever,
    just as he promised our ancestors.”

56 __PERSON_D__ stayed with __PERSON_B__ for about three months and then returned home.

The Birth of __PERSON_C__ the Baptist
57 When it was time for __PERSON_B__ to have her baby, she gave birth to a son. 58 Her neighbors and relatives heard that the __MASTER_A__ had shown her great mercy, and they shared her joy.

59 On the eighth day they came to circumcise the __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__, and they were going to name him after his father __PERSON_A__, 60 but his mother spoke up and said, “No! He is to be called __PERSON_C__.”

61 They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who has that name.”

62 Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__. 63 He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone’s astonishment he wrote, “His name is __PERSON_C__.” 64 Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue set free, and he began to speak, praising __MOST_HIGH_A__. 65 All the neighbors were filled with awe, and throughout the __LOCAL_PLACE_02__ people were talking about all these things. 66 Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, “What then is this __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__ going to be?” For the __MASTER_A__ hand was with him.

__PERSON_A__ Song
67 His father __PERSON_A__ was filled with the __SPIRIT_A__ and prophesied:

68 “Praise be to the __MASTER_A__, the __MOST_HIGH_A__ of __PEOPLE_A__,
    because he has come to his people and redeemed them.
69 He has raised up a horn[c] of salvation for us
    in the house of his __LOCAL_ROLE_02__ __KING_A__
70 (as he said through his holy __LOCAL_ROLE_01__ of long ago),
71 salvation from our enemies
    and from the hand of all who hate us—
72 to show mercy to our ancestors
    and to remember his holy covenant,
73     the oath he swore to our father __ANCESTOR_A__:
74 to rescue us from the hand of our enemies,
    and to enable us to serve him without fear
75     in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

76 And you, my __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__, will be called a __LOCAL_ROLE_01__ of the __HONORED_A__;
    for you will go on before the __MASTER_A__ to prepare the way for him,
77 to give his people the knowledge of salvation
    through the forgiveness of their sins,
78 because of the tender mercy of our __MOST_HIGH_A__,
    by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven
79 to shine on those living in darkness
    and in the shadow of death,
to guide our feet into the path of peace.”

80 And the __LOCAL_ENTITY_01__ grew and became strong in spirit[d]; and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to __PEOPLE_A__.
translations:
引言  
1 许多人已着手编写我们中间所成就事迹的记载，2 就如那些从起初作见证和 __LOCAL_ROLE_02__ 道的人传给我们的那样。3 我自己既然从头仔细考察了一切，便也决定为你，有最尊贵的 __RECIPIENT_A__，写一卷有条理的记述，4 叫你知道所学之事的确实性。  

预言施洗者 __PERSON_C__ 的诞生  
5 在 __LOCAL_PLACE_01__ 王 __RULER_A__ 时代，有一位 __WORKER_A__ 名叫 __PERSON_A__，属于 __DIVISION_A__ 的祭司班次；他的妻子 __PERSON_B__ 也是 __FOREFATHER_B__ 的后裔。6 两人都在至高者 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前义行无瑕，遵守所有 __MASTER_A__ 的诫命和律例。7 但他们无子，因为 __PERSON_B__ 无法怀孕，且两人年事已高。  

8 有一次， __PERSON_A__ 的班次值勤，他在至高者面前当 __WORKER_A__，9 按祭司的规矩抽签，被选中进入 __MASTER_A__ 的 __PLACE_A__ 燃烧 __MATERIAL_A__。10 当焚烧 __MATERIAL_A__ 的时候，所有聚集的敬拜者都在外面等待。  

11 这时， __MASTER_A__ 的天使向他显现，站在 __LOCAL_OBJECT_01__ 的右边。12 __PERSON_A__ 见到他，惊慌害怕。13 天使对他说：“不要害怕， __PERSON_A__，你的 __REQUEST_A__ 已蒙垂听。你的妻子 __PERSON_B__ 要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫 __PERSON_C__。14 他将带给你喜乐和欢欣，许多人因他的诞生欢喜，15 因他在 __MASTER_A__ 面前大有作为。他不可喝酒或醉酒，且从胎内充满 __SPIRIT_A__。16 他将使众 __PEOPLE_A__ 归向他们的至高者 __MASTER_A__。17 他必以先知 __PROPHET_A__ 的灵与能力在主面前行，将父亲的心转向儿女，使悖逆的归向义人的智慧，预备一群合适的人归顺 __MASTER_A__。”  

18 __PERSON_A__ 问天使：“我怎样能确信这事呢？我已经年老，我妻子也年纪甚高。”  

19 天使说：“我是 __MESSENGER_B__，常侍至高者 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前，奉差遣对你说话，并将这美事报给你。20 直到这事成就那日，你必闭口不能言语，因为你不信我的话，这话到了定期就必应验。”  

21 这时众人等候 __PERSON_A__，奇怪他为何在 __PLACE_A__ 留了那么久。22 他出来不能与他们说话，他们知道他在 __PLACE_A__ 看见异象，因为他不停比手势给他们看，却无法言语。  

23 职任期满，他回家。24 之后，他妻子 __PERSON_B__ 怀孕，隐藏了五个月。25 她说：“这是 __MASTER_A__ 为我所行的事，这几日他眷顾我，除去了民间我的羞辱。”  

预言 __PERSON_F__ 诞生  
26 在 __PERSON_B__ 怀孕第六个月，至高者 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 差遣天使 __MESSENGER_B__ 到位于 __REGION_A__ 的 __VILLAGE_A__ 镇。27 天使被差到一位 __LOCAL_ROLE_03__，她已订婚，未婚夫名为 __PERSON_E__，是 __KING_A__ 的后裔。该 __LOCAL_ROLE_03__ 名叫 __PERSON_D__。28 天使对她说：“蒙恩的女子，你好！主与你同在。”  

29 __PERSON_D__ 因此话大大惊奇，思索这问候为何意。30 天使又说：“不要怕， __PERSON_D__，你在至高者面前蒙恩。31 你将怀孕生子，给他起名叫 __PERSON_F__。32 他将为大，被称为至尊者的子。主至高者要赐他他父亲 __KING_A__ 的宝座，33 他必君王统治 __ANCESTOR_B__ 的后裔，国度永无终结。”  

34 __PERSON_D__ 问天使：“这事怎么会成呢？我还是个 __LOCAL_ROLE_03__。”  

35 天使回答说：“圣灵要临到你，至尊者的能力要荫庇你。故所要生的圣者必称为至高者的子。36 你亲戚 __PERSON_B__ 也怀了子，尽管她年老且素来不能怀孕，现已怀孕六个月。37 因为至高者的话绝不会落空。”  

38 __PERSON_D__ 说：“我是主的 __LOCAL_ROLE_02__，愿照你的话成就在我身上。”随即天使离开她。  

__PERSON_D__ 探望 __PERSON_B__  
39 此时 __PERSON_D__ 起身急往 __LOCAL_PLACE_02__ 的一个城镇，40 进入 __PERSON_A__ 家，向 __PERSON_B__ 问安。41 __PERSON_B__ 听到 __PERSON_D__ 的问安，胎儿在腹中跳动， __PERSON_B__ 充满了圣灵。42 她大声说：“你在女人中是有福的，你所怀的孩子也是有福的！43 为什么我蒙此恩，主的母亲竟来我这里？44 你的问安声音一入耳，腹中胎儿就欢跃。45 信主应许的，真是有福了！”  

__PERSON_D__ 的颂歌  
46 __PERSON_D__ 说：  

“我的心尊主为大，  
47 我的灵以我的救主至高者 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 喜乐，  
48 因他顾念了他卑微的仆人，  
从今以后，万代要称我有福。  
49 因全能者为我成就了大事，  
他的名为圣。  
50 他怜悯敬畏他的人，  
直到万代。  
51 他用膀臂施展大能，  
驱散心怀骄傲的人。  
52 他使有权柄的离位，  
却高举卑微人。  
53 他使饥饿的人得美食，  
却叫富足的人空手回去。  
54 他扶助他的仆人以色列，  
记念施怜悯给我们的祖先，  
55 就像他对他们祖宗所应许的那样，直到永远。”  

56 __PERSON_D__ 在 __PERSON_B__ 家住了约三个月，然后回去。  

施洗者 __PERSON_C__ 的诞生  
57 到了 __PERSON_B__ 临产的时候，她生了一个儿子。58 邻居亲友听说主怜悯她，就和她一同欢喜。  

59 第八天，他们要给孩子行割礼，准备按父亲 __PERSON_A__ 的名字给他命名，60 但母亲说：“不可，姓名要叫 __PERSON_C__。”  

61 他们说：“你亲戚中无人叫这名字。”  

62 便用手势问孩子的父亲想叫他什么名。63 他要求书写板，众人惊讶他写着：“他的名字是 __PERSON_C__。”64 随即他的口开通，舌头释放，他开始说话，赞美至高者 __MOST_HIGH_A__。65 邻居们都惊奇，到 __LOCAL_PLACE_02__ 听见这事的人都议论。66 凡听见的都揣摩这孩子将成为什么样的人，因为主的手与他同在。  

__PERSON_A__ 的颂歌  
67 他父亲 __PERSON_A__ 被圣灵充满，讲预言说：  

68 “我们应当称赞主，   
至高者，以色列的神，  
69 因他来看顾他的百姓，救赎他们。  
70 他为我们兴起了救恩的角，  
在他仆人 __KING_A__ 家里，  
71 就如古时他圣先知所说，  
72 使我们从仇敌手中得拯救，  
73 施怜悯给我们的列祖，  
并记念他与他们所立的圣约，  
74 他向我们祖宗亚伯拉罕所起的誓言：  
75 要救我们脱离仇敌的手，  
使我们终身在圣洁公义中，  
无所畏惧地事奉他。  

76 你，孩子，将被称为至尊者的先知，  
要在主面前预备道路，  
77 给他的百姓带来救恩的知识，  
通过罪得赦免，  
78 因我们至高者的慈悲，  
天上的晨光要照耀我们，  
79 照耀在黑暗或死亡阴影中的人，  
引导我们的脚步行走平安之路。”  

80 孩子渐渐长大，心灵坚强，在旷野生活，直到他显现给以色列人。
